title: OpenXR (Quest Link): black screen in stereo with 'unused shader variant'/null pipeline spam — Vulkan and D3D12, 4.6–4.7.2
body:
### Godot version

4.6.stable.official.89cea1439 — also verified on 4.6.3-stable and 4.7.2-stable.

### System information

- Windows 10 19045 x64
- GPU: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060, driver 580.88 (Vulkan API 1.4.312)
- OpenXR runtime: Meta Quest Link (reports as `Oculus 1.207.0`), Quest 3 headset over Quest Link (cable)
- Godot binaries: official `win64.exe` builds

### Issue description

With OpenXR enabled and a Quest 3 connected via Quest Link, the XR session initializes successfully (session state reaches focused, controllers track, haptic pulses work), but **nothing is rendered**: the headset shows black and the desktop mirror window is black as well. The log spams the following error block every frame:

```
ERROR: Condition "!variants_enabled[p_variant]" is true. Returning: RID()
ERROR: Condition "shader.is_null()" is true.
ERROR: Attempted to use an unused shader variant (shader is null),
ERROR: Parameter "pipeline" is null.
ERROR: This render pipeline requires (0) bytes of push constant data, supplied: (96)
ERROR: No render pipeline was set before attempting to draw.
```

This reproduces:

- on a **minimal scene** (XROrigin3D + XRCamera3D + one BoxMesh) — not scene-dependent;
- on **both RD drivers**: Vulkan (`Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+`) and D3D12 (`rendering_device/driver.windows="d3d12"`, `D3D12 12_0 - Forward+`);
- on Godot **4.6, 4.6.3 and 4.7.2**.

**Workaround:** `renderer/rendering_method="gl_compatibility"` renders the same scene correctly with zero errors at a stable 72 fps over Link.

Possibly relevant details:

- The runtime reports `XrGraphicsRequirementsVulkan2KHR: minApiVersionSupported 1.0.0, maxApiVersionSupported 1.2.0` while the engine creates a Vulkan 1.4 instance (`Vulkan 1.4.312` in the log). The D3D12 path fails the same way, though, so a Vulkan-version binding mismatch alone may not be the whole story.
- Known older fixes for OpenXR black screens do not apply: VRS is off (`rendering/vrs/mode = 0`), foveation off (`xr/openxr/foveation_level = 0`), MSAA off (`msaa_3d = 0`), no upscaling/scaling.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install the Meta Horizon Link PC app, connect a Quest 3 via Quest Link, set it as the active OpenXR runtime.
2. Create a project with the three files below, run it (F5).

`project.godot`:
```ini
config_version=5

[application]

config/name="min_xr"
run/main_scene="res://xr_cube.tscn"
config/features=PackedStringArray("4.6")

[rendering]

renderer/rendering_method="forward_plus"

[xr]

openxr/enabled=true
```

`xr_init.gd`:
```gdscript
extends Node3D

func _ready() -> void:
	var xr := XRServer.find_interface("OpenXR")
	if xr != null and xr.initialize():
		get_viewport().use_xr = true
		print("[MINXR] ok: ", xr.get_name())
	else:
		print("[MINXR] no XR")
```

`xr_cube.tscn`:
```
[gd_scene load_steps=3 format=3]

[ext_resource type="Script" path="res://xr_init.gd" id="1"]

[sub_resource type="BoxMesh" id="BoxMesh_1"]

[node name="MinXR" type="Node3D"]
script = ExtResource("1")

[node name="XROrigin" type="XROrigin3D" parent="."]

[node name="Cam" type="XRCamera3D" parent="XROrigin"]

[node name="Box" type="MeshInstance3D" parent="."]
transform = Transform3D(1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 1.2, -2)
mesh = SubResource("BoxMesh_1")
```

### Log output (Vulkan run)

```
Godot Engine v4.6.stable.official.89cea1439
OpenXR: Created instance for OpenXR 1.1.54
OpenXR: Running on OpenXR runtime:  Oculus   1.207.0
OpenXR: XrGraphicsRequirementsVulkan2KHR:
 - minApiVersionSupported:  1.0.0
 - maxApiVersionSupported:  1.2.0
Vulkan 1.4.312 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
[MINXR] ok: OpenXR
ERROR: Condition "!variants_enabled[p_variant]" is true. Returning: RID()
ERROR: Condition "shader.is_null()" is true.
ERROR: Attempted to use an unused shader variant (shader is null),
ERROR: Parameter "pipeline" is null.
ERROR: This render pipeline requires (0) bytes of push constant data, supplied: (96)
ERROR: No render pipeline was set before attempting to draw.
... (the block repeats every frame; nothing is ever drawn)
```

D3D12 run (`rendering_device/driver.windows="d3d12"`):
```
OpenXR: xrGetD3D12GraphicsRequirementsKHR:
D3D12 12_0 - Forward+ - Using Device #0: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
[MINXR] ok: OpenXR
... (identical error block every frame, black screen)
```

Workaround run (`gl_compatibility`):
```
OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 580.88 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060
OpenXR: Requested OpenGL version does not meet the minimum version this runtime supports.
OpenXR: Trying to initialize with OpenGL anyway...
[MINXR] ok: OpenXR
(zero errors, scene renders at stable 72 fps)
```
